description: Human-reviewed ground truth for tests/Fixtures/GroundTruth/CallShapes (audit B1 Oracle C). Each fact is an edge that must be present once the B1 extractor work lands: CallShapes.App is the caller project, CallShapes.Core declares every target. Adapter-emitted edges (Registers, RoutesTo, Handles) and non-compared kinds (Returns, Throws, MayDispatchTo, StaticallyCalls, Implements, Inherits, ExtensionReceiver, Declares) are out of scope for this oracle; GoldenAdapterTests and the Phase 7 exact-set test cover them separately.
symbol_id_format: Facts carry the Roslyn documentation-comment id only. The snapshot id is 'docCommentId|assemblyDisplayName' (SymbolIdFactory.Make); append the assembly from the projects list, or resolve the doc id against the snapshot. Doc ids are unique across the two projects in this fixture.
mapping: Invocations in a body (including implicit ones: foreach GetEnumerator/MoveNext, using Dispose, await GetAwaiter/GetResult, deconstruction Deconstruct, collection-initializer Add, operator and conversion methods, interpolated-string-handler appends) are 'Calls' to the resolved method.

Object creation and attribute construction are 'Constructs' to the constructed type and 'Calls' to the bound constructor when it is declared in source (an implicitly declared constructor gets no 'Calls'). Constructor initializers and primary-constructor base arguments are 'Calls' to the constructor.
Method groups, delegate conversions and event += handlers are 'MethodGroupRef' (B1 decision: new kind, provenance compiler_proved).
Event access is 'Writes' to the event for += and -=, and 'Reads' for any other use (for example a raise); the handler of += is also a 'MethodGroupRef'.
Field and property initializers are owned by the field/property symbol; expression-bodied property getters are owned by the accessor method symbol (accessors are declared symbols).
Static member-access invocations additionally emit 'References' to the receiver type; parameter-type and member-type references come from the existing parameter/structural extractors.

Parameter default values, enum member values, field-like event initializers and attribute arguments are walked like bodies. Owner: the method (an indexer parameter: the indexer property; a delegate parameter: the delegate type), the enum field, the event, and the attributed symbol (a parameter or return-value attribute: its method).

Type uses are 'References' to every source type named in a body (is and type patterns, explicit casts, default(T), sizeof, array creation, local declarations, catch types, method and constructor type arguments; typeof is 'ReflectionTypeRef') and to every type inside a member or parameter type (type arguments, array elements).

excluded.reason: Program.cs app.MapGet("/shape", ...) wires an endpoint to a handler; the ASP.NET Core adapter recognizes only Controller-derived types, so the route-to-handler edge is not modeled. The handler body's call to CoreApi.MinimalApiTarget is still a fact.
AddHostedService<ShapeHostedService> resolves the concrete type (Registers edge, runtime_unknown provenance) but the hosted-service activation lifecycle is not captured.
AddOptions<ShapeOptions>().Configure(...) resolves the options type (Registers edge, runtime_unknown provenance) but configuration-binding semantics are not captured.

FromCollectionAdd: a collection expression whose target type has Add lowers to the constructor plus one Add call per element. Roslyn exposes the constructor (ICollectionExpressionOperation.ConstructMethod) but not the Add calls, and not the GetEnumerator of a spread element. ShapeAddOnly.Add has no incoming edge by design.

notes.reason: FromDynamic binds a dynamic receiver; a dynamic invocation has no statically resolved symbol, so it must surface as binding incompleteness rather than an edge. The CoreApi.DynamicTarget() call in the same body is a normal Calls fact.

'original with { Id = ... }' is lowered to the synthesized copy constructor/clone on ShapeRecord; the fixture records the property write (Writes -> ShapeRecord.Id) and the initializer call (Calls -> CoreApi.RecordTarget). Whether the lowered clone call also emits a fact is left to the Phase 7 mapping decision; the clone symbol is declared as M:CallShapes.Core.ShapeRecord.{Clone}$.

FromCollectionExpression returns [1, 2, 3]. Array types have no persisted symbol (no T:System.Int32[] row in the snapshot), so the array construction cannot be a persistable edge target; the construct is present for crash/incompleteness coverage.
C# requires attribute constructor arguments to be compile-time constants, so the only extractable fact in [ShapeMarker(19)] is the construction of ShapeMarkerAttribute.

C# requires default parameter values to be compile-time constants, so no call can occur in one. The fixture exercises the omitted-argument call shape instead (FromOmittedArgument calls OmittedArgumentTarget without passing its constant default).

The call to the C# 14 extension block binds, in the current extractor, to a compiler-generated nested symbol (M:CallShapes.Core.ShapeTextExtensions.<G>$0A9D361FAFE148655B241EBC2970963E.BlockWordCount); the fact above records the callable extension member M:CallShapes.Core.ShapeTextExtensions.BlockWordCount(CallShapes.Core.ShapeText) as the intended target. Part D step 3 (B3): calls to block methods target the implementation on the outer class (AssociatedExtensionImplementation). Reads and writes of block properties target the block property (P:…<G>$….Name) by design. Accessor bodies are owned by the implementation accessor.

Measured on the committed fixture with the local Release build: the implementation part of a partial method is never walked, so no edge from OnShapePartial exists in the snapshot. The facts for OnShapePartial are the intended ones; the audit's Phase 7 extractor fix must make them appear.

The interpolated-string-handler construction itself is compiler-lowered. Oracle C records the append calls (AppendLiteral/AppendFormatted) and the ShapeLog.Write call; it does not record a Constructs edge for the synthesized handler creation.

Facts whose source is a body the current extractor already walks (classic extension, interface calls, local function, query lambda, async iterator, ref struct, unsafe, accessor bodies, static constructor, operator reads, type-level References) are copied from the measured snapshot; the C# 14 block-extension call is the one normalised exception. They are included so the Phase 7 exact-set test can diff the whole corpus rather than a subset.

NestedDerived.Value overrides NestedBase.Value. The Overrides edge is outside this oracle's kinds; the B20 self-index check in Part D step 3 covers Overrides, Declares, Returns and Throws from nested types.
